SELECT #{execID} cstpTradeId, /*下行交易编号*/ pre.trade_id preTradeId, /*预录入交易编号*/ pre.share_amt*100 matchNum, /*匹配额度*/ '0' matchType, /*匹配方式：自动匹配*/ pre.trade_date tradeDate, /*交易日期*/ '01' fSysId /*上游系统：cstp*/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE pre LEFT JOIN fin_product fin ON fin.finprod_id=pre.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO secstl ON secstl.sec_acct_id=pre.sec_manage_acct_id LEFT JOIN stl_capacct_info capacct ON capacct.acct_no =secstl.trd_acct_id Left join sys_user u on u.user_name=pre.trader WHERE pre.trade_date=to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') /*交易日期*/
AND fin.finprod_market_id=#{securityID} /*资产代码*/
AND pre.trade_market=#{tradeMarket} /*交易市场*/ AND pre.ps=#{side} /*交易方向*/ AND pre.settle_speed=#{settleSpeed} /*清算速度*/ AND pre.unit_cprice=#{price} /*净价*/ AND pre.yield=#{yield2} /*到期收益率*/
AND pre.exer_yield=#{strikeyield} /*行权收益率*/
and pre.TERM_DAYS = #{repoTerm}
AND pre.share_amt*100=#{lastqty} /*券面总额*/ AND capacct.busi_acct_no=#{ourdepositaccountnumber} /*证券账号*/ AND u.real_name=#{traderName}/*交易员名称*/ AND not exists (select 1 from TRD_MATCH_INFO match where match.pre_trade_id=pre.trade_id)/*剔除已经匹配的预录入交易*/ order by pre.trade_date
